findings.issue: Car-blood slice budget replenishes on wall clock gaps within one render frame
findings.evidence: cbFrame returns only when performance.now()-cbFrameStamp <=5; after5ms it resets cbFrameLeft to clamp(gap*.14,3,9). cbSlice invokes it per job; several cars can refill the shared budget in the same renderer pass.
findings.measured: Visible first/warm vehicle pass averages26.07/20.75ms per frame; own module probe worstSlice27.1ms, next26.4ms,176.6ms fitting over16slices.

findings.issue: Cold shader/material variants enter on first pursuit helicopter and first wrecks
findings.evidence: renderHiccups events in07-heavy-render-first.json:6programs at t4.1 (police helicopter);4programs at t6.1 (asset-char-cut/finish and MeshBasic sheets).
findings.limit: This dev page skipped title prewarm: prewarm.done false,compiled0. Do not generalize this to fully prewarmed production.

findings.issue: Visible multi-wreck fight adds draw work and alpha overdraw
findings.evidence: Corrected visible scene has3burning wrecks;~310camera+249shadow submissions and1.32Mtriangles in first visible sample; effects one shared draw near1000live slots.
findings.limit: Earlier phases07–09 had wrecks above the viewport; they remain partial controls, not visible multi-wreck evidence.

caveats: SwiftShader wall-clock FPS and GL blocking time are not a hardware GPU benchmark.
V8 sampling profiles include blocked native GL calls and can be dominated by uniformMatrix4fv/getProgramParameter while software GL drains. Use page thread CPU and named pass costs with this limit.
Some early profiles include first navigation graph/minimap bakes. They are retained as cold controls.
cbSlice is cooperative, so frame-serial budgeting still needs bounded job yields to prevent a single large slice; observed own worstSlice exceeds9ms.
No source optimizations were made during this profiling pass.
